items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Bingie until I went to sit in over there, the Tango Palace, and I saw this fellow and we're talking about Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: Well, I did a few odds and ends in

different places until I joined Ernie. That was the end of that segment, the two years I spent in New York. I knew most of the musicians but they were all established in famous bands and things like that. They're not looking for anybody. They're looking for people that was better known than I was. I wasn't known then, just serving my apprentice here and there. I used to go sit in many of the taxi dance on Broadway just to keep my lip up. There used to be a guy called Bingie Madison and he played at the Tango…
A taxi dance for the benefit of those who -- for future reference, how would you describe a taxi dance?
